[EN] Echoes in the Stone
[ES] Eco en la piedra
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please gather some nexulitic fragments. They're the key.
[ES] Por favor, reúne algunos fragmentos nexulíticos. Son la clave.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you. I'll do my best not to betray your expectations.
[ES] Gracias. Haré todo lo posible por no defraudar tus expectativas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I hope it pays off."
[ES] "Espero que valga la pena."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect nexulitic fragments across Val Kaeli.
[ES] Recolecta fragmentos nexulíticos en Val Kaeli.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the fragments to the {@LinkCreature:1022#1003} at Kanstria.
[ES] Entrega los fragmentos al {@LinkCreature:1022#1003} en Kanstria.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
